description: From the Mirador de Orellán, the Roman mine landscape spreads out below in dark, jagged silhouettes — the famous red pinnacles and gullies of Las Médulas standing black against a sky full of stars. Two thousand years ago Roman engineers washed these hills away for gold, leaving this strange, beautiful ruin of a landscape. Under the stars, the silent towers of earth look almost lunar.
